Case No. 1842 16112022

Date: 2011.

Approximate Time: N/A.

Weather: N/A.

Season: N/A.

Witnesses: K. S. B. and J. B. V. Reported by E. D. C., aged 33.

Description: At 22:46 hours on November 16, 2022, the SEFAA received, through its web platform, a report of the sighting of an allegedly anomalous aerial phenomenon near the El Tepual airport in Puerto Montt, on an unspecified date in 2011.

A portion of that sighting was captured on a video, which the informant attached to the report.

On November 17, 2022, the user was contacted to request specifics regarding the information provided, such as the exact date, the identity of the individuals who made the recording, and the submission of a copy of the original material.

On November 21, 2022, the informant responded, stating that they definitely do not have the exact date, but that one of the witnesses claims it occurred during 2011, despite it being listed as such in the file.

Creation date in the year 2003 and that he entered it into the system as January 1, 2012 because, according to him, the system did not allow him to put a date prior.

He also identified the witnesses, a mother with her daughter, with their names and surnames and said that the daughter is a friend of his. He said they were the women who traveled in the vehicle, who made the recording and whose voices are heard in the video.

According to the user, the video was made with the camera of a Sony Ericsson w100a Spiro cellular phone.

As the informant wrote in his report that the phenomenon was observed while the witnesses were traveling down the road towards El Tepual Airport in Puerto Montt, the case was georeferenced at a point between the city and the aerodrome at the geographic coordinates 41° 26' 21.14" South Latitude and 73° 2' 23.11" West Longitude. (Figure 1)

Figure 1. The red dot shows a location between the city of Puerto Montt and El Tepual Airport, where the reported phenomenon was observed.

The sent videos last 7 minutes and 31 seconds, and 52 seconds, respectively. In both recordings, the conversation is heard and the excitement of the witnesses is evident, but it is not possible to distinguish what they describe as...
a blue light that approaches them or descends. The video quality is not
good and the movements are not fluid at all.

One of the videos has a size of only 563 KB, while the other weighs
3,458 KB.
Unable to discern in the images what the witnesses claim to have seen,

Not having the exact date of the observation and due to the number of years that have passed, it is not possible to adequately study the report to even propose a theory that explains what was reported.

Images: As support for the report, two MP4 videos were received, which had been converted, and later the originals in 3GP format. A table of one of the videos is attached below for illustrative purposes.

Conclusion: Since there is no specific date for the observation, further investigation is required.

Despite it being in 2011, and the evidence provided not being studyable, the case was closed according to numeral 2f (Only cases up to one year old and meeting the previous criteria will be investigated directly. Those older than that time frame will only be studied if they have original photographic images or videos) of the Technical Instruction on Procedures, Investigation Timelines, Reception, Processing of Executive Reports and Archiving of Reports SEFAA.

The case was classified as "Narrative".
